#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create thesis-ready figures from the curated Phase 1/2 result files."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUTPUT = ROOT / "figures" / "phase2"


def load(relative: str) -> dict:
    return json.loads((ROOT / relative).read_text())


def behavioral_figure() -> None:
    discovery = load("outputs/bracket_matching/matched_discovery_behavior.json")
    confirmation = load("outputs/bracket_matching/matched_confirmation_behavior.json")
    closers = (")", "]", "}")
    columns = [(depth, distance) for depth in range(1, 5) for distance in ("short", "long")]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 4.7), constrained_layout=True)
    for axis, payload, title in zip(axes, (discovery, confirmation), ("Descoberta", "Confirmação")):
        condition = payload["behavioral_summary"]["paired_accuracy_by_condition"]
        matrix = np.asarray([[condition[f"{closer}|d{depth}|{distance}"] for depth, distance in columns] for closer in closers])
        image = axis.imshow(matrix, vmin=0, vmax=1, cmap="YlGn", aspect="auto")
        axis.set_title(f"{title}: acurácia pareada por condição", loc="left", fontweight="bold")
        axis.set_yticks(range(3), labels=closers)
        axis.set_xticks(range(len(columns)), labels=[f"d{d}\n{'curta' if s == 'short' else 'longa'}" for d, s in columns])
        for row in range(matrix.shape[0]):
            for column in range(matrix.shape[1]):
                axis.text(column, row, f"{matrix[row, column]:.0%}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8)
    fig.colorbar(image, ax=axes, label="Acurácia")
    fig.savefig(OUTPUT / "delimiter_behavioral_heatmap.pdf")
    fig.savefig(OUTPUT / "delimiter_behavioral_heatmap.png", dpi=180)
    plt.close(fig)


def candidate_figure() -> None:
    payload = load("outputs/bracket_matching/candidate_confirmation.json")
    singles = [row for row in payload["results"] if len(row["head_set"]) == 1]
    labels = [f"L{row['head_set'][0][0]}H{row['head_set'][0][1]}" for row in singles]
    modes = (("zero_damage_mean", "Zero"), ("mean_damage_mean", "Média"), ("resample_damage_mean", "Reamostragem"))
    x = np.arange(len(labels))
    width = 0.24
    fig, axis = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.8), constrained_layout=True)
    for index, (field, label) in enumerate(modes):
        axis.bar(x + (index - 1) * width, [row[field] for row in singles], width, label=label)
    axis.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=.7)
    axis.set_xticks(x, labels=labels)
    axis.set_ylabel("Dano normalizado")
    axis.set_title("Validação causal em templates não vistos", loc="left", fontweight="bold")
    axis.legend(frameon=False, ncols=3)
    fig.savefig(OUTPUT / "delimiter_candidate_baselines.pdf")
    fig.savefig(OUTPUT / "delimiter_candidate_baselines.png", dpi=180)
    plt.close(fig)


def component_figure() -> None:
    payload = load("outputs/bracket_matching/component_patching_discovery.json")
    components = payload["component_patching"]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 3.8), constrained_layout=True)
    for component, color in (("resid_post", "#2f6f4e"), ("attn_out", "#4f83cc"), ("mlp_out", "#d17c36")):
        rows = sorted((row for row in components if row["component"] == component), key=lambda row: row["layer"])
        axes[0].plot([row["layer"] for row in rows], [row["bidirectional_score"] for row in rows], marker="o", ms=3, label=component, color=color)
    axes[0].set(title="Localização por camada", xlabel="Camada", ylabel="Pontuação bidirecional")
    axes[0].legend(frameon=False)
    heads = load("outputs/bracket_matching/causal_discovery.json")["head_patching"][:10]
    axes[1].barh(
        [f"L{row['layer']}H{row['head']}" for row in reversed(heads)],
        [row["bidirectional_score"] for row in reversed(heads)], color="#4f83cc",
    )
    axes[1].set(title="Heads candidatas", xlabel="Pontuação bidirecional")
    fig.savefig(OUTPUT / "delimiter_localization.pdf")
    fig.savefig(OUTPUT / "delimiter_localization.png", dpi=180)
    plt.close(fig)


def induction_figure() -> None:
    rows = load("outputs/induction_heads/calibration_confirmation.json")["synthetic_aggregate"]
    labels = [f"L{row['head'][0]}H{row['head'][1]}" for row in rows]
    fig, axis = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.8), constrained_layout=True)
    x = np.arange(len(rows)); width = .24
    for offset, (field, label) in enumerate((("zero_selective_drop_mean", "Zero"), ("mean_selective_drop_mean", "Média"), ("resample_selective_drop_mean", "Reamostragem"))):
        axis.bar(x + (offset - 1) * width, [row[field] for row in rows], width, label=label)
    axis.set_xticks(x, labels=labels)
    axis.set_ylabel("Queda causal seletiva")
    axis.set_title("Induction heads: sensibilidade ao baseline", loc="left", fontweight="bold")
    axis.legend(frameon=False, ncols=3)
    fig.savefig(OUTPUT / "induction_baseline_sensitivity.pdf")
    fig.savefig(OUTPUT / "induction_baseline_sensitivity.png", dpi=180)
    plt.close(fig)


def main() -> None:
    OUTPUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    behavioral_figure()
    candidate_figure()
    component_figure()
    induction_figure()
    print(f"wrote figures to {OUTPUT}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Verify the pinned environment and SantaCoder loading path."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.metadata as metadata
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from scripts.patch_santacoder import REVISION, ensure_santacoder_transformers_compat
from transformer_lens import HookedTransformer

EXPECTED_VERSIONS = {
    "torch": "2.6.0+cpu",
    "transformers": "4.57.6",
    "transformer-lens": "2.17.0",
}


def check_versions() -> None:
    for package, expected in EXPECTED_VERSIONS.items():
        actual = metadata.version(package)
        if actual != expected:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{package} version mismatch: expected {expected}, got {actual}")


def main() -> int:
    check_versions()

    print("Compatibility patch results:")
    for result in ensure_santacoder_transformers_compat():
        print(f"  {result}")

    print("\nLoading SantaCoder with TransformerLens...")
    model = HookedTransformer.from_pretrained(
        "santacoder", device="cpu", revision=REVISION
    )

    print("\nLoaded model summary:")
    print(f"  device={model.cfg.device}")
    print(f"  dtype={next(model.parameters()).dtype}")
    print(f"  n_layers={model.cfg.n_layers}")
    print(f"  n_heads={model.cfg.n_heads}")
    print(f"  d_model={model.cfg.d_model}")
    print(f"  n_ctx={model.cfg.n_ctx}")
    print(f"  tokenizer={model.cfg.tokenizer_name}")
    print(f"  revision={REVISION}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
